data.name: Tales of Evion: Forgotten Dreams
data.detailed_description:
Tales of Evion: Forgotten Dreams is a story-driven fantasy RPG set in an entirely rewritten reality. After the fairy Fortune recreates the world using the Illusion Pearl of Fate, every kingdom, every person, and every destiny is changed. Tashy, now living a new life with no memory of the world that existed before, begins a journey to uncover the truth behind this strange reality and the mysterious Voices calling to her.

Story

Tashy believes she is an ordinary village girl until she discovers an Illusion Pearl containing a Voice identical to her own. This Voice reveals that the world around her is not the original reality. As Tashy follows the guidance of the Voices, she travels across Evion in search of the remaining Illusion Pearls, slowly uncovering the truth behind Fortune’s recreated world and her own hidden power.

Strategic Turn-Based Combat

Build a party of allies who are also living rewritten lives. Engage in strategic battles using magic, skills, elemental advantages, equipment, and teamwork. Face enemies and bosses across Evion as you customize your party and strengthen their abilities.

Explore a Rewritten World

Journey across the many kingdoms of Evion, each transformed by Fortune’s illusion. Travel through frozen frontiers, volcanic lands, underwater kingdoms, sky villages, desert realms, and more. Each region has new histories, rewritten identities, and mysteries that lead deeper into the truth of Evion’s altered reality.

Additional Features

• Side quests that expand the rewritten lore of Evion

• Optional challenge areas and unique game modes

• A dynamic soundtrack tailored to each kingdom

• Dungeons, puzzles, and ancient trials

• A cast of characters whose rewritten lives evolve as the story progresses

Character Progression and Customization

Level up your party, unlock new abilities, discover unique equipment, and explore optional dungeons and trials. As characters grow, their personalities, rewritten roles, and hidden truths unfold through story progression and side quests.

What Makes It Unique

Tales of Evion: Forgotten Dreams combines emotional storytelling, illusion-based magic, and classic turn-based RPG combat. The game focuses on uncovering the truth within a world that has been entirely rewritten, where the past has been erased, and the future depends on what Tashy chooses to discover.

data.short_description: Play as Tashy, a girl with no past, guided by mysterious Voices locked inside ancient pearls. Battle through illusions, unlock powerful Dreamcaster spells, face the darkness within yourself, and reclaim the world that was stolen.
